clips.title: Kyu-chan Helps with Store Sales
grammar: 〜んじゃないですか — isn't it / don't you think

lines.ja: 東京都荒川区にある大衆酒場「栃木屋」さん。
lines.en: The pub Tochigi-ya, located in Arakawa Ward, Tokyo.
lines.speaker: Narrator

lines.ja: このお店の看板動物がおしゃべり大好き、九官鳥の九ちゃんです。
lines.en: This tavern's star mascot is Kyu-chan the hill myna, who loves to talk.
lines.speaker: Narrator

lines.ja: 実はこの九ちゃんが達者なおしゃべりでお店の売り上げアップに協力しているんだとか。
lines.en: Apparently, Kyu-chan helps boost shop sales with its clever talking.
lines.speaker: Narrator

lines.ja: ええ、協力してますよ。エサ代ぐらい稼ぐんじゃないですか？
lines.en: Yes, he helps out. He probably earns enough to cover his own food expenses, wouldn't you say?
lines.speaker: Owner

clips.title: Saying Goodbye to the Parrot
grammar: 〜そう — appears to be / looks like

lines.ja: ピーちゃん、お出かけしてくるね。
lines.en: Pii-chan, I'm heading out for a bit, okay?
lines.speaker: Owner

lines.ja: さあ、お母さんがお出かけするようです。
lines.en: Now, it looks like Mother is heading out.
lines.speaker: Narrator

clips.title: Asking for More Apple
grammar: 〜ない？ — question asking for confirmation / invitation
〜てくれる — doing something for someone's sake

lines.ja: 終わりね。食べない？いらない？
lines.en: All done, right? Won't you eat? Don't want any?
lines.speaker: Owner

lines.ja: 食べた感想。でも、これだけじゃありません。
lines.en: His review after eating! But that's not all.
lines.speaker: Narrator
